sentences.text: Shri H.K. Golhani, learned counsel for the applicant.

Shri Gopal Jaiswal, learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/
Heard on admission.
Record of the Courts below be called for.
Heard on I.A. No.20585/2021, application filed by the applicant for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

T h e applicant stands convicted under Section 16 (1A)(ii) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 6 months and and fine of Rs.5,000/- with default stipulation.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in jail and the present revision would likely to take time for its final disposal.
He further submits that a strong case of acquittal is made out against the applicant and prays for his suspension till disposal of this revision.

It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.20,000/- (Rs. Twenty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on 10.01.2022 and on all other subsequent dates as may be fixed by the court in this regard, the remain part of the substantive jail sentence imposed upon the applicant shall stand suspended and he shall be released on bail.
I
t is further directed that if the applicant is found indulged in any criminal activity during suspension of his jail sentence, the temporary bail granted in this case shall stand cancelled.
I.A. No.20585/2021 stands allowed and disposed of Signature Not CC as per rules.
